description_en: Queries the list of active sessions in the sandbox of a specified managed agent by paging, and returns the session source and external channel type
description_zh: 分页查询指定托管智能体的 Sandbox 中的活动 Session 列表，并返回会话来源及外部渠道类型
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-sandbox-sessions --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --sandbox-id sbx-2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSandboxSessions

parameters.help_en: The sandbox ID. You can call ListSandboxes to query the sandbox ID
parameters.help_zh: Sandbox ID，可通过 ListSandboxes 查询
parameters.name: sandbox_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for querying the next page
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value SUCCESS is returned if the request was successful
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request was successful

items.description_en: The list of active sessions in the sandbox
items.description_zh: 该 Sandbox 的活动 Session 列表

channelType.description_en: The external channel type, such as DINGTALK, FEISHU, or WECOM. This parameter is empty for non-external channels
channelType.description_zh: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空
channelType.title_en: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空
channelType.title_zh: 外部渠道类型，例如 DINGTALK、FEISHU、WECOM；非外部渠道为空

sessionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the active session
sessionId.description_zh: 活动 Session 的唯一标识

sourceType.description_en:
The session source type. Valid values:
API: API call.
CONSOLE_DEBUG: Console debugging.
EXTERNAL_CHANNEL: External channel.
UNKNOWN: Unknown source
sourceType.description_zh: Session 来源类型。API 表示 API 调用，CONSOLE_DEBUG 表示控制台调试，EXTERNAL_CHANNEL 表示外部渠道，UNKNOWN 表示来源未知

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. The value success is returned if the request was successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more results are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的分页令牌；为空表示没有更多结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合本次查询条件的记录总数
